references.text: God swears that those who despised him will not see the land he promised to their fathers
Caleb is mentioned as an exception because of his faithfulness and willingness to follow the Lord
Confirms that only Caleb and Joshua survived from those who were mustered in the wilderness of Sinai
Moses repeats God's oath that only Caleb and Joshua would see the promised land
God swears that none of that evil generation will see the land, except Caleb
Joshua son of Nun shall lead Israel into the land
Caleb reminds them of God's promise given at Kadesh-Barnea that he would inherit the land
Caleb showed faith by encouraging the people to take possession of the land
God raised his hand (swore) to give the land to Abraham's offspring
The book of Hebrews refers to this generation as those who were not allowed to enter rest because of unbelief
